notes: NP_11 s10's obsolescence audit as the sim runs it (PAC-095). Per milestone, the three earliest-recruitable fighters are built for the current endgame with live systems only - every step a verb the sim refuses when its rule is unmet: the endgame's XP (his own XP curve applied), the three ascensions on Spirits and the trials marked by the trials' own code paths, the board by the aid's picks, the raises on his lowest stat, a kit from the live sources (the shop's open shelves, the masters' open lessons) chosen so every move answers a motion, the gear the locker and the shop fit. Viability is NP_11 s10's three - tier 4, a competitive board, a coherent technique kit - and holding the endgame: half his segments won or more against the endgame's bosses in spars on the profile. A fighter who falls short names the failing system, not himself. The late recruits are built the same way as the reference. The level, the budget, the flags, the seeds and the thresholds are first drafts; the budget is the economy lane's to set.
